out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED A COLANDER IN THE BACK HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED COLANDER AND UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD BE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW EGGS STORED OVER SAUCES IN THE THREE-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED COOLER DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THAT RAW FOODS SHOULD BE STORED BELOW ANY READY-TO-EAT FOODS.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: OBSERVED INTERIOR OF ICE MACHINE IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PIC BEGAN TO CLEAN ICE MACHINE DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THE ICE MACHINE IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED/SANITIZED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED DUCK AT 45F AND COOKED PORK BELLY AT 47F IN THE 4-DRAWER PREP-TOP COOLER. OBSERVED COCONUT MILK AT 44F AND RICE AT 44F IN THE 1 -DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED/DISCARDED OF FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE FOUR-DRAWER PREP-TOP AT 48F AND THE ONE-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER AT 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED/MOVED TCS FOODS OUT OF TEMPERATURE AND CONTACTED A REPAIR TECHNICIAN DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THESE COOLERS ARE NOT USED UNTIL THEY ARE REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVED A FEW NON-NSF STORAGE CONTAINERS USED TO STORE FOOD ITEMS; OBSERVED SOME GROCERY BAGS USED TO STORE FOODS DIRECTLY.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. PIC BEGAN MOVING FOODS TO NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS DURING THE INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS GROCERY BAGS/NON-NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS SHOULD NOT BE USED AS THEY ARE NOT FOOD-GRADE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVED SOME FOOD ITEMS STORED DIRECTLY IN GROCERY BAGS DURING INSPECTION. OBSERVED SOME FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS THAT ARE NOT NSF-APPROVED (EX. CABBAGE STORAGE BINS)
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. PIC REMOVED FOOD ITEMS FROM GROCERY BAGS AND UNDERSTANDS FOOD ITEMS SHOULD NOT BE STORED DIRECTLY IN GROCERY BAGS AS THEY ARE NOT NSF-APPROVED AND NOT FOOD-GRADE. PIC ALSO UNDERSTANDS STORAGE CONTAINERS SHOULD BE REPLACED WITH NSFD OR EQUIVALENT CONTAINERS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE FLOORS/WALLS AROUND COOK-LINE AND DISHWASHING MACHINE AREA IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE AREAS SHOULD BE CLEANED THOROUGHLY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED ABOVE VARIOUS VEGETABLES IN THREE-DOOR UPR COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED EGGS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS RAW MEATS/EGGS SHOULD NOT BE STORED ABOVE ANY READY-TO-EAT FOODS.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food is not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: OBSERVED CURRY SAUCE IN LARGE POT WITH A LID MADE THE EVENING PRIOR TO INSPECTION AT 82F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED SAUCE DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COOLING FOODS SHOULD NOT BE STORED IN LARGE PORTIONS WITH LIDS. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS COOL FROM 135F TO 70F WITHIN 2 HOURS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED THAI CURRY SAUCE AT 49F, CUT CABBAGE MIXED WITH CARROTS AT 46F, STICKY RICE AT 52F, GREENY CURRY SAUCE AT 45F, AND BEAN SPROUTS AT 49-52F IN THREE-DOOR UPR COOLER. OBSERVED FRIED TOFU AT 61F IN TWO-DOOR PREP TOP AT 61F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOOD ITEMS, DEPENDING ON WHEN THEY WERE MADE. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES. PLEASE ENSURE THIS COOLER IS ONLY USED FOR NON- TCS FOODS UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS IN BOTTLES/CONTAINERS WITHOUT A LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOOD ITEMS NOT IN ITS ORIGINAL CONTAINER SHOULD HAVE A LABEL.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: OBSERVED ICE MACHINE SOILED TO SIGHT AND TOUCH.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PLEASE ENSURE ICE MACHINE IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED AND SANITIZED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: In-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED TWO KNIVES STUCK BETWEEN PREP-TOP UNIT AND WALL.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC REMOVED KNIVES DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS IN-USE UTENSILS SHOULD NOT BE STORED BETWEEN PREP-TOPS.
